{{dablink|For other uses of the words "black" and "eye," the meaning of ''Seia Doon'', see [[Black]] and [[Eye]].}}
The '''''Seia Doon''''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior society|warrior society]]. The name means "Black Eyes" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Roles==
''Seia Doon'' are often used in the questioning of prisoners, as well as ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.{{ref/book|8|11}}. The Black Eyes are specialists in fighting during the twilight hours, and are excellent at finding their way in little to no light.

==Activities==
Members of the ''Seia Doon'', along with members of the ''[[Aethan Dor]]'', ''[[Far Aldazar Din]]'', ''[[Duadhe Mahdi'in]]'', ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'', and ''[[Sha'mad Conde]]'', helped [[Rand al'Thor]] find a [[Portal Stone]] outside [[Tear]].{{ref/book|4|22}} As they are traveling through the [[Aiel Waste|Three-Fold Land]], members of the ''Seia Doon'' escort [[Hadnan Kadere]]'s wagons.{{ref/book|5|7}} When [[Couladin]] defies Aiel custom and tradition by claiming he is the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'', the rest of his society, the ''Seia Doon'', vow to kill him.{{ref/book|5|23}}. All of the societies, including the ''Seia Doon'', accompanied Rand from the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]] to [[Caemlyn]] in [[Andor]] to battle [[Rahvin]] and his forces.{{ref/book|5|54}} ''Seia Doon'' is one of the societies that guard the Sun Palace while Rand is there.{{ref/book|6|28}} ''Seia Doon'', ''[[Shae'en M'taal]]'', and ''Far Dareis Mai'' are all very touchy about ''[[ji'e'toh]]''.{{ref/book|6|28}}
